# Overview

End-to-end replication of the BRCA aging-clock framework with **GTEx, TCGA, SCAN-B, and METABRIC scored on a common gene universe**.

Pipeline:

1. Load canonical GTEx/TCGA logCPM and metadata (output of `01_processing_clean_template`)
2. Process SCAN-B SE (raw counts → logCPM → symbol-collapsed)
3. Process METABRIC ESet (microarray log-intensity → symbol-collapsed); native `Pam50_SUBTYPE` retained as-is
4. Compute intersection of gene symbols available in all four cohorts (common universe)
5. Hallmark ssGSEA per cohort on the common universe
6. Retrain elastic-net clock on GTEx
7. Apply clock to TCGA / SCAN-B / METABRIC; compute GTEx-anchored deviation
8. Run ClockSHAP with GTEx as reference
9. Build figure panels (PCA, anchored age, ClockSHAP heatmaps, PAM50 deviation, pathway × PAM50)
10. Overall survival (Cox + KM) stacked across TCGA-BRCA + SCAN-B + METABRIC
11. Stability diagnostics: Hallmark coverage, original-vs-retrained clock comparison, METABRIC composition

Some panels may not appear in the published manuscript. Panels are assembled and
typeset in Adobe Illustrator to produce the final figure.

# 1. Load canonical GTEx + TCGA

```{r load_canonical}
proc_dir <- params$proc_dir
stopifnot(dir.exists(proc_dir))

logcpm_gtex_sym <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, "logcpm_gtex_sym-PC.rds"))
logcpm_nt_sym   <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, "logcpm_nt_sym-PC.rds"))
logcpm_pt_sym   <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, "logcpm_pt_sym-PC.rds"))
metadata        <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, "sample_metadata.rds"))

vcat("GTEx logCPM:",    paste(dim(logcpm_gtex_sym), collapse = " x "))
vcat("TCGA-NAT logCPM:", paste(dim(logcpm_nt_sym),   collapse = " x "))
vcat("TCGA-PT logCPM:", paste(dim(logcpm_pt_sym),   collapse = " x "))
```

# 2. Process SCAN-B (counts → logCPM, symbol-collapsed)

Same logic as `06_scanb_processing_BRCA`: best replicate per Sample by ALIGNED_PAIRS, primary invasive tumors only, edgeR logCPM, Ensembl → SYMBOL collapse by mean.

```{r scanb_process}
scanb <- readRDS(params$scanb_se_rds)

# Best replicate per Sample, invasive primary tumors only
cd <- as.data.frame(colData(scanb))
cd$run_id <- rownames(cd)

best_replicates <- cd |>
  group_by(Sample) |>
  slice_max(order_by = ALIGNED_PAIRS, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup()

scanb_best <- scanb[, best_replicates$run_id]

cd2 <- as.data.frame(colData(scanb_best))
is_normal <- cd2$SpecimenType %in% "Normal"
is_ln     <- cd2$SpecimenType %in% "LN"
is_dcis   <- cd2$OpBiopsy.InvCa %in% "In situ only"
drop <- is_normal | is_ln | is_dcis
drop[is.na(drop)] <- FALSE
scanb_tumor <- scanb_best[, !drop]

# Add age_years (5-year binned)
age_col <- "Age..5.year.range..e.g...35.31.35...40.36.40...45.41.45..etc.."
colData(scanb_tumor)$age_years <- as.numeric(colData(scanb_tumor)[[age_col]])

# Counts → logCPM
logcpm_scanb <- edgeR::cpm(assay(scanb_tumor, "counts"), log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)

# Ensembl → SYMBOL, collapse duplicates by mean
.ensembl_to_symbol <- function(ensembl_ids) {
  bare <- sub("\\.\\d+$", "", ensembl_ids)
  syms <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
    org.Hs.eg.db, keys = bare, keytype = "ENSEMBL",
    column = "SYMBOL", multiVals = "first"
  )
  names(syms) <- ensembl_ids
  syms
}

.collapse_to_symbols <- function(mat, symbols) {
  keep <- !is.na(symbols) & symbols != ""
  mat <- mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  symbols <- symbols[keep]
  summed <- rowsum(mat, group = symbols)
  counts <- table(symbols)[rownames(summed)]
  sweep(summed, 1, as.numeric(counts), "/")
}

syms_scanb       <- .ensembl_to_symbol(rownames(logcpm_scanb))
logcpm_scanb_sym <- .collapse_to_symbols(logcpm_scanb, syms_scanb)

vcat("SCAN-B symbol-level logCPM:", paste(dim(logcpm_scanb_sym), collapse = " x "))
```

# 3. Process METABRIC (microarray, symbol-collapsed)

```{r metabric_process}
mb_eset <- readRDS(params$metabric_eset_rds)

metabric_se <- SummarizedExperiment(
  assays  = list(intensity = Biobase::exprs(mb_eset)),
  colData = as.data.frame(Biobase::pData(mb_eset)),
  rowData = as.data.frame(Biobase::fData(mb_eset))
)

colData(metabric_se)$age_years <- as.numeric(colData(metabric_se)$AGE_AT_DIAGNOSIS)

mb_expr <- assay(metabric_se, "intensity")
mb_expr <- mb_expr[rowSums(is.na(mb_expr)) == 0, , drop = FALSE]  # GSVA needs complete rows

mb_syms          <- as.character(rowData(metabric_se)[rownames(mb_expr), "Hugo_Symbol"])
logcpm_metab_sym <- .collapse_to_symbols(mb_expr, mb_syms)

vcat("METABRIC symbol-level (microarray log-intensity):", paste(dim(logcpm_metab_sym), collapse = " x "))
```

# 4. Common gene universe across all four cohorts

```{r common_universe}
universe_common <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  rownames(logcpm_gtex_sym),
  rownames(logcpm_nt_sym),
  rownames(logcpm_pt_sym),
  rownames(logcpm_scanb_sym),
  rownames(logcpm_metab_sym)
))

cohort_sizes <- tibble::tibble(
  cohort  = c("GTEx","TCGA-NAT","TCGA-PT","SCAN-B","METABRIC"),
  n_genes = c(
    nrow(logcpm_gtex_sym), nrow(logcpm_nt_sym), nrow(logcpm_pt_sym),
    nrow(logcpm_scanb_sym), nrow(logcpm_metab_sym)
  )
)
cohort_sizes
vcat("Common universe size:", length(universe_common))

logcpm_gtex_c  <- logcpm_gtex_sym  [universe_common, , drop = FALSE]
logcpm_nt_c    <- logcpm_nt_sym    [universe_common, , drop = FALSE]
logcpm_pt_c    <- logcpm_pt_sym    [universe_common, , drop = FALSE]
logcpm_scanb_c <- logcpm_scanb_sym [universe_common, , drop = FALSE]
logcpm_metab_c <- logcpm_metab_sym [universe_common, , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(rownames(logcpm_gtex_c), rownames(logcpm_metab_c)))
```

# 5. Hallmark ssGSEA on the common universe

`alpha = 0.25`, `normalize = FALSE` (matches `01_processing`). RNA-seq cohorts (GTEx + TCGA-NAT + TCGA-PT + SCAN-B) are scored together; METABRIC scored separately because microarray log-intensity has a different distribution from logCPM.

```{r run_ssgsea}
hallmark_sets <- local({
  nice <- function(x) x |>
    str_remove("^HALLMARK_") |>
    str_replace_all("_", " ") |>
    str_to_title()
  hall_raw <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H")
  split(hall_raw$gene_symbol, nice(hall_raw$gs_name))
})

run_ssgsea <- function(expr_mat) {
  param <- ssgseaParam(
    exprData  = expr_mat,
    geneSets  = hallmark_sets,
    minSize   = 1,
    maxSize   = Inf,
    alpha     = 0.25,
    normalize = FALSE
  )
  gsva(param, verbose = FALSE)
}

# Combine all RNA-seq cohorts into one ssGSEA call
expr_rnaseq   <- cbind(logcpm_gtex_c, logcpm_nt_c, logcpm_pt_c, logcpm_scanb_c)
scores_rnaseq <- run_ssgsea(expr_rnaseq)

n_g <- ncol(logcpm_gtex_c); n_n <- ncol(logcpm_nt_c); n_p <- ncol(logcpm_pt_c)
scores_gtex  <- scores_rnaseq[, seq_len(n_g), drop = FALSE]
scores_nt    <- if (n_n > 0) scores_rnaseq[, seq.int(n_g + 1, n_g + n_n), drop = FALSE] else scores_rnaseq[, 0, drop = FALSE]
scores_pt    <- scores_rnaseq[, seq.int(n_g + n_n + 1, n_g + n_n + n_p), drop = FALSE]
scores_scanb <- scores_rnaseq[, -(seq_len(n_g + n_n + n_p)), drop = FALSE]

scores_metab <- run_ssgsea(logcpm_metab_c)

vcat("ssGSEA dims | GTEx:", paste(dim(scores_gtex), collapse=" x "),
     " | NAT:", paste(dim(scores_nt), collapse=" x "),
     " | PT:", paste(dim(scores_pt), collapse=" x "),
     " | SCAN-B:", paste(dim(scores_scanb), collapse=" x "),
     " | METABRIC:", paste(dim(scores_metab), collapse=" x "))
```

# 6. Train elastic-net clock on GTEx

Mirrors `02_aging_clock_clean_template_elnet`: age-stratified 10-fold CV, search over alpha × lambda, MAE objective.

```{r train_clock}
meta_gtex <- metadata[colnames(scores_gtex), , drop = FALSE]
x_gtex <- t(scores_gtex)
y_gtex <- meta_gtex$age_years
keep_train <- is.finite(y_gtex)
x_gtex <- x_gtex[keep_train, , drop = FALSE]
y_gtex <- y_gtex[keep_train]
names(y_gtex) <- rownames(x_gtex)

# Stratified folds by age decile
k <- params$n_folds
age_bin <- dplyr::ntile(y_gtex, 10)
foldid <- integer(length(y_gtex))
for (b in sort(unique(age_bin))) {
  idx <- which(age_bin == b)
  foldid[idx] <- sample(rep(seq_len(k), length.out = length(idx)))
}

alpha_grid <- as.numeric(params$alpha_grid)
alpha_grid <- alpha_grid[is.finite(alpha_grid)]
if (length(alpha_grid) == 0) alpha_grid <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)
alpha_grid <- sort(unique(alpha_grid))

lambda_grid <- 10 ^ seq(params$lambda_min_exp, params$lambda_max_exp, length.out = params$n_lambda)
get_idx <- function(cvfit, lam) which.min(abs(cvfit$lambda - lam))

tune_list <- vector("list", length(alpha_grid))
names(tune_list) <- as.character(alpha_grid)

for (i in seq_along(alpha_grid)) {
  a <- alpha_grid[i]
  cvfit_a <- cv.glmnet(
    x = x_gtex, y = y_gtex,
    alpha = a, family = "gaussian",
    foldid = foldid,
    type.measure = "mae",
    lambda = lambda_grid,
    standardize = TRUE, intercept = TRUE
  )
  idx_min <- get_idx(cvfit_a, cvfit_a$lambda.min)
  idx_1se <- get_idx(cvfit_a, cvfit_a$lambda.1se)
  tune_list[[i]] <- list(
    alpha = a, cvfit = cvfit_a,
    lambda_min = cvfit_a$lambda[idx_min], mae_min = cvfit_a$cvm[idx_min], nzero_min = cvfit_a$nzero[idx_min],
    lambda_1se = cvfit_a$lambda[idx_1se], mae_1se = cvfit_a$cvm[idx_1se], nzero_1se = cvfit_a$nzero[idx_1se]
  )
}

tune_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(tune_list, function(z) tibble(
  alpha=z$alpha, lambda.min=z$lambda_min, MAE.min=z$mae_min, nzero.min=z$nzero_min,
  lambda.1se=z$lambda_1se, MAE.1se=z$mae_1se, nzero.1se=z$nzero_1se
))) %>% arrange(alpha)

metric_col <- if (params$lambda_choice == "lambda.min") "MAE.min" else "MAE.1se"
lambda_col <- if (params$lambda_choice == "lambda.min") "lambda.min" else "lambda.1se"
nzero_col  <- if (params$lambda_choice == "lambda.min") "nzero.min" else "nzero.1se"
best_row    <- tune_tbl %>% dplyr::slice(which.min(.data[[metric_col]]))
best_alpha  <- best_row$alpha
best_lambda <- best_row[[lambda_col]]
best_mae    <- best_row[[metric_col]]
best_nzero  <- best_row[[nzero_col]]

vcat("Best clock | alpha=", best_alpha, " lambda=", signif(best_lambda,4),
     " MAE=", signif(best_mae,4), " nzero=", best_nzero)

enet_model <- glmnet(
  x = x_gtex, y = y_gtex,
  alpha = best_alpha, family = "gaussian", lambda = best_lambda,
  standardize = TRUE, intercept = TRUE
)

# Training scalers (for ClockSHAP-standardized form)
x_center <- if (!is.null(enet_model$xm)) enet_model$xm else colMeans(x_gtex, na.rm = TRUE)
x_scale  <- if (!is.null(enet_model$xs)) enet_model$xs else apply(x_gtex, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
x_scale[!is.finite(x_scale) | x_scale == 0] <- 1
if (is.null(names(x_center))) names(x_center) <- colnames(x_gtex)
if (is.null(names(x_scale)))  names(x_scale)  <- colnames(x_gtex)

feat <- colnames(x_gtex)
```

# 7. Apply clock + GTEx-anchored deviation

GTEx anchoring: predicted − (β0 + β1 × age), where (β0, β1) come from `lm(predicted ~ age)` on GTEx only. For a linear clock this is identical to ClockSHAP's deviation.

```{r predict_all}
predict_clock <- function(scores_pxs, label) {
  X <- t(scores_pxs[feat, , drop = FALSE])
  pred <- as.numeric(predict(enet_model, newx = X, s = best_lambda))
  names(pred) <- rownames(X)
  list(X = X, pred = pred, label = label)
}

pred_gtex_l  <- predict_clock(scores_gtex,  "GTEx")
pred_nt_l    <- predict_clock(scores_nt,    "TCGA-NAT")
pred_pt_l    <- predict_clock(scores_pt,    "TCGA-PT")
pred_scanb_l <- predict_clock(scores_scanb, "SCAN-B")
pred_metab_l <- predict_clock(scores_metab, "METABRIC")

# GTEx anchoring line
age_gtex_vec <- y_gtex[names(pred_gtex_l$pred)]
ok_g <- complete.cases(pred_gtex_l$pred, age_gtex_vec)
bias_fit <- lm(pred_gtex_l$pred[ok_g] ~ age_gtex_vec[ok_g])
beta0 <- coef(bias_fit)[1]; beta1 <- coef(bias_fit)[2]
vcat("GTEx anchoring | beta0=", signif(beta0,4), " beta1=", signif(beta1,4))

build_df <- function(pred_l, age_vec, cohort_label) {
  ids <- names(pred_l$pred)
  age <- as.numeric(age_vec[ids])
  tibble(
    sample_id = ids, cohort = cohort_label,
    age_years = age,
    predicted = as.numeric(pred_l$pred),
    pred_anchored = as.numeric(pred_l$pred - beta0 + (1 - beta1) * age),
    deviation = as.numeric(pred_l$pred - (beta0 + beta1 * age))
  ) %>% filter(is.finite(age_years), is.finite(predicted))
}

age_gtex_full  <- setNames(metadata$age_years, rownames(metadata))
age_nt_full    <- age_gtex_full
age_pt_full    <- age_gtex_full
age_scanb_full <- setNames(as.numeric(colData(scanb_tumor)$age_years),  colnames(scanb_tumor))
age_metab_full <- setNames(as.numeric(colData(metabric_se)$age_years),  colnames(metabric_se))

df_gtex  <- build_df(pred_gtex_l,  age_gtex_full,  "GTEx")
df_nt    <- build_df(pred_nt_l,    age_nt_full,    "TCGA-NAT")
df_pt    <- build_df(pred_pt_l,    age_pt_full,    "TCGA-PT")
df_scanb <- build_df(pred_scanb_l, age_scanb_full, "SCAN-B")
df_metab <- build_df(pred_metab_l, age_metab_full, "METABRIC")

all_df <- bind_rows(df_gtex, df_nt, df_pt, df_scanb, df_metab) %>%
  mutate(cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("GTEx","TCGA-NAT","TCGA-PT","SCAN-B","METABRIC")))
```

# 8. ClockSHAP per tumor cohort (GTEx as reference)

```{r build_clockshap}
coef_mat <- as.matrix(coef(enet_model))
a_orig <- as.numeric(coef_mat[1,1])
b_orig <- setNames(as.numeric(coef_mat[-1,1]), rownames(coef_mat)[-1])[feat]
mu     <- x_center[feat]
sigma  <- x_scale[feat]

beta_cs  <- b_orig * sigma
alpha_cs <- a_orig + sum(b_orig * mu, na.rm = TRUE)

clock_cs <- ClockSHAP::linear_clock(
  alpha = as.numeric(alpha_cs),
  beta  = beta_cs,
  mu    = mu,
  sigma = sigma
)

ref_X <- x_gtex
ref_age <- y_gtex
names(ref_age) <- rownames(ref_X)
ok_r <- is.finite(ref_age)
reference <- ClockSHAP::fit_reference_profile(
  features = as.data.frame(ref_X[ok_r, , drop = FALSE]),
  age      = ref_age[ok_r]
)

run_cs <- function(scores_pxs, age_vec, label) {
  X <- t(scores_pxs[feat, , drop = FALSE])
  ids <- rownames(X)
  age <- as.numeric(age_vec[ids])
  names(age) <- ids
  ok <- is.finite(age)
  cs <- ClockSHAP::clockshap(
    features  = X[ok, , drop = FALSE],
    age       = age[ok],
    clock     = clock_cs,
    reference = reference
  )
  list(cs = cs, ids = rownames(X[ok, , drop = FALSE]), label = label)
}

cs_pt    <- run_cs(scores_pt,    age_pt_full,    "TCGA-PT")
cs_scanb <- run_cs(scores_scanb, age_scanb_full, "SCAN-B")
cs_metab <- run_cs(scores_metab, age_metab_full, "METABRIC")
cs_nt    <- run_cs(scores_nt,    age_nt_full,    "TCGA-NAT")

# Sanity: rowSums(phi) ≈ deviation
sapply(list(PT = cs_pt, SCANB = cs_scanb, METAB = cs_metab, NT = cs_nt),
       function(o) max(abs(rowSums(o$cs$phi) - o$cs$deviation), na.rm = TRUE))
```

# 9. TP53 attach (binary, for heatmap annotation only)

We retain a simple Mut/WT TP53 status for SCAN-B and METABRIC purely for the heatmap annotation column. TCGA's TP53 is already attached in `metadata$TP53` from `01_processing`. No quantitative TP53 analysis is performed in this script.

```{r tp53_attach}
# METABRIC: cBioPortal MAF; deleterious classes
mb_mut <- readr::read_tsv(params$metabric_tp53_tsv, show_col_types = FALSE)
keep_classes_metab <- c(
  "Missense_Mutation","Nonsense_Mutation",
  "Frame_Shift_Del","Frame_Shift_Ins",
  "Splice_Site","Splice_Region",
  "In_Frame_Del","In_Frame_Ins"
)
tp53_mut_metab <- mb_mut |>
  dplyr::filter(Gene == "TP53", `Mutation Type` %in% keep_classes_metab) |>
  dplyr::pull(`Sample ID`) |> unique()
SummarizedExperiment::colData(metabric_se)$TP53 <- ifelse(
  colnames(metabric_se) %in% tp53_mut_metab, "Mut", "WT"
)

# SCAN-B: Brueffer 2020 SnpEff
scanb_mut <- readr::read_tsv(params$scanb_tp53_tsv, comment = "##", show_col_types = FALSE)
keep_classes_scanb <- c("Missense","Nonsense","Frameshift","Splicing","In-frame indel")
tp53_mut_scanb <- scanb_mut |>
  dplyr::filter(gene.symbol == "TP53", SnpEff.Effect.Class %in% keep_classes_scanb) |>
  dplyr::pull(SAMPLE) |> unique()

scanb_ids_full   <- colnames(scanb_tumor)
scanb_ids_match  <- sub("\\.k2\\.a\\.t$", "", scanb_ids_full)
cohort_ids_scanb <- unique(scanb_mut$SAMPLE)
tp53_vec_scanb <- rep(NA_character_, length(scanb_ids_full))
names(tp53_vec_scanb) <- scanb_ids_full
in_cohort_scanb <- scanb_ids_match %in% cohort_ids_scanb
tp53_vec_scanb[in_cohort_scanb] <- ifelse(
  scanb_ids_match[in_cohort_scanb] %in% tp53_mut_scanb, "Mut", "WT"
)
SummarizedExperiment::colData(scanb_tumor)$TP53 <- tp53_vec_scanb

cat("TP53 attach summary:\n")
cat("  METABRIC:  Mut=", sum(colData(metabric_se)$TP53 == "Mut"),
    " | WT=",            sum(colData(metabric_se)$TP53 == "WT"), "\n")
cat("  SCAN-B:    Mut=", sum(tp53_vec_scanb == "Mut", na.rm = TRUE),
    " | WT=",            sum(tp53_vec_scanb == "WT",  na.rm = TRUE),
    " | NA=",            sum(is.na(tp53_vec_scanb)),  "\n")
cat("  TCGA-BRCA: Mut=", sum(metadata$TP53 == "Mut", na.rm = TRUE),
    " | WT=",            sum(metadata$TP53 == "WT",  na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

# 10. Figures

```{r fig_setup}
fig_out_dir <- params$fig_out_dir
dir.create(fig_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cohort_cols_full <- c(
  "GTEx"     = "#4daf4a",
  "TCGA-NAT" = "#377eb8",
  "TCGA-PT"  = "#e41a1c",
  "SCAN-B"   = "#fdae6b",
  "METABRIC" = "#984ea3"
)
cohort_labels_full <- c(
  "GTEx"     = "GTEx-Breast",
  "TCGA-NAT" = "TCGA-BRCA NAT",
  "TCGA-PT"  = "TCGA-BRCA Tumor",
  "SCAN-B"   = "SCAN-B Tumor",
  "METABRIC" = "METABRIC Tumor"
)
```

## PCA on Hallmark ssGSEA (common universe)

PCA on the per-cohort Hallmark ssGSEA score matrices (all five cohorts
scored against the **common gene universe** — section 4/5 output). Because
every cohort here was scored against the *same* gene set, residual
separation along the leading PCs reflects platform + biology, not
gene-availability mismatch. SCAN-B is randomly subsampled before fitting
(controlled by `params$panelA_scanb_subsample_n`, default 1500) so its
~6k samples don't dominate either the variance decomposition or the
plot density. Save dimensions: 200 × 150 mm.

```{r panelA}
cohort_scores_list <- list(
  "GTEx"     = scores_gtex,
  "TCGA-NAT" = scores_nt,
  "TCGA-PT"  = scores_pt,
  "SCAN-B"   = scores_scanb,
  "METABRIC" = scores_metab
)
cohort_scores_list <- cohort_scores_list[vapply(cohort_scores_list, ncol, integer(1)) > 0]

# Subsample SCAN-B before the PCA so its ~6k samples don't dominate either the
# variance structure or the dot density on the plot. Other cohorts pass through
# unchanged. NULL or non-finite param = no subsampling.
scanb_n_target <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(params$panelA_scanb_subsample_n))
if ("SCAN-B" %in% names(cohort_scores_list) &&
    is.finite(scanb_n_target) && scanb_n_target > 0) {
  scanb_full_n <- ncol(cohort_scores_list[["SCAN-B"]])
  if (scanb_full_n > scanb_n_target) {
    keep_idx <- sort(sample.int(scanb_full_n, size = scanb_n_target))
    cohort_scores_list[["SCAN-B"]] <-
      cohort_scores_list[["SCAN-B"]][, keep_idx, drop = FALSE]
    vcat(sprintf("PCA: SCAN-B downsampled %d -> %d",
                 scanb_full_n, scanb_n_target))
  } else {
    vcat(sprintf("PCA: SCAN-B has %d samples, below target %d — using all",
                 scanb_full_n, scanb_n_target))
  }
}

# All cohorts share the same Hallmark row set (common universe), but intersect
# defensively in case a pathway dropped out due to size filters.
common_paths <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(cohort_scores_list, rownames))
vcat("PCA cohorts: ", paste(names(cohort_scores_list), collapse = ", "),
     " | shared Hallmarks: ", length(common_paths),
     " | samples per cohort: ",
     paste(sprintf("%s=%d", names(cohort_scores_list),
                   vapply(cohort_scores_list, ncol, integer(1))),
           collapse = ", "))

combined_mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(cohort_scores_list,
                                      function(s) s[common_paths, , drop = FALSE]))
cohort_vec <- unlist(mapply(
  function(name, s) rep(name, ncol(s)),
  names(cohort_scores_list), cohort_scores_list,
  SIMPLIFY = FALSE
), use.names = FALSE)

pca_fit <- prcomp(t(combined_mat), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
ve <- round(100 * pca_fit$sdev^2 / sum(pca_fit$sdev^2), 1)

pc_df <- as.data.frame(pca_fit$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cohort = factor(
    cohort_vec,
    levels = intersect(names(cohort_cols_full), unique(cohort_vec))
  ))

p_panelA <- ggplot(pc_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, colour = cohort)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cohort_cols_full, labels = cohort_labels_full) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", ve[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", ve[2], "%)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    legend.title     = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 13)
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3)))

p_panelA

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(fig_out_dir, "PCA_Hallmark_ssGSEA.pdf"),
  plot     = p_panelA,
  width    = 3, height = 3, units = "in"
)
```

## Representative ClockSHAP waterfall (TCGA-BRCA; not used in the manuscript)

Single TCGA-BRCA tumor in middle-deviation range with readable top-N |phi|
bars. Preserved here as a diagnostic.

```{r waterfall}
pick_pretty_waterfall_sample <- function(cs, top_n = 10,
                                         dev_q = c(0.20, 0.80),
                                         min_bar = 2.5) {
  stopifnot(inherits(cs, "clockshap"))
  phi <- cs$phi
  ids <- rownames(phi)
  if (is.null(ids)) stop("ClockSHAP object has no rownames for phi.", call. = FALSE)

  ok  <- is.finite(cs$deviation) & is.finite(cs$expected) & is.finite(cs$predicted)
  phi <- phi[ok, , drop = FALSE]; dev <- cs$deviation[ok]; ids <- ids[ok]

  lo <- unname(stats::quantile(dev, dev_q[1], na.rm = TRUE))
  hi <- unname(stats::quantile(dev, dev_q[2], na.rm = TRUE))
  keep <- dev >= lo & dev <= hi

  phi2 <- phi[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  ids2 <- ids[keep]
  if (nrow(phi2) == 0) stop("No samples left after dev_q filtering.", call. = FALSE)

  top_abs  <- t(apply(abs(phi2), 1, function(v) sort(v, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(top_n)]))
  min_top  <- apply(top_abs, 1, min)
  mean_top <- rowMeans(top_abs)
  cand <- which(min_top >= min_bar)
  if (length(cand) == 0) cand <- seq_len(nrow(phi2))
  ids2[cand[which.max(mean_top[cand])]]
}

sample_id <- pick_pretty_waterfall_sample(cs = cs_pt$cs, top_n = 10,
                                          dev_q = c(0.20, 0.80), min_bar = 2.5)
cat("Representative BRCA sample:", sample_id, "\n")

p_waterfall <- ClockSHAP::plot_clockshap_waterfall(
  x                   = cs_pt$cs,
  sample              = sample_id,
  top_n               = 8,

  show_delta_label    = TRUE,
  show_effect_labels  = TRUE,

  y_axis_title        = NULL,
  deviation_label     = "Age-Matched Deviation = {value} yr",
  expected_age_label  = "Expected Age (GTEx)\n{value} yr",
  predicted_age_label = "Tumor Predicted Age\n{value} yr",
  effect_label        = "{value}"
) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.margin  = margin(t = 20, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10)
  )
```

## ClockSHAP heatmaps (TCGA-BRCA + SCAN-B + METABRIC; not used in the manuscript)

Three heatmaps with shared color scales and annotation palette. TCGA-BRCA holds row labels and legends; SCAN-B and METABRIC inherit BRCA's hierarchical row order.

```{r panelC_build}
build_phi_mat <- function(cs_obj) {
  phi <- cs_obj$cs$phi
  dev <- cs_obj$cs$deviation
  ids <- rownames(phi)
  ok <- is.finite(dev)
  phi <- phi[ok, , drop = FALSE]; dev <- dev[ok]; ids <- ids[ok]
  ord <- order(dev, decreasing = FALSE)
  phi <- phi[ord, , drop = FALSE]; dev <- dev[ord]; ids <- ids[ord]
  mat <- t(phi); colnames(mat) <- ids
  mat <- mat[rowSums(abs(mat), na.rm = TRUE) != 0, , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(mat)[rownames(mat) == "Reactive Oxygen Species Pathway"] <- "ROS Pathway"
  list(mat = mat, dev = dev, ids = ids)
}

brca_b  <- build_phi_mat(cs_pt)
scanb_b <- build_phi_mat(cs_scanb)
metab_b <- build_phi_mat(cs_metab)

# Cluster on BRCA — others inherit the row ordering
hc_brca        <- hclust(dist(brca_b$mat))
brca_row_order <- rownames(brca_b$mat)[hc_brca$order]
scanb_b$mat <- scanb_b$mat[intersect(brca_row_order, rownames(scanb_b$mat)), , drop = FALSE]
metab_b$mat <- metab_b$mat[intersect(brca_row_order, rownames(metab_b$mat)), , drop = FALSE]

# Shared color scales
all_dev <- c(brca_b$dev, scanb_b$dev, metab_b$dev)
dev_col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(min(all_dev, na.rm = TRUE), 0, max(all_dev, na.rm = TRUE)),
  c("darkblue", "white", "darkred")
)
phi_lim <- max(as.numeric(stats::quantile(
  c(abs(brca_b$mat), abs(scanb_b$mat), abs(metab_b$mat)),
  probs = 0.99, na.rm = TRUE
)), 1e-6)
phi_col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(-phi_lim, 0, phi_lim),
  c("steelblue", "white", "firebrick")
)

# Shared annotation palettes
pam_cols_shared <- c(
  Basal="#d73027", Her2="#fc8d59", LumA="#4575b4", LumB="#91bfdb",
  `Normal-Like`="#cccccc", Unclassified="grey70"
)
tp53_cols_shared <- c(WT = "grey85", Mut = "black", Unknown = "white")
pam_levels_full  <- names(pam_cols_shared)
tp53_levels_full <- names(tp53_cols_shared)

clean_pam <- function(x) {
  x[is.na(x) | x == "" | x == "NC"] <- "Unclassified"
  factor(dplyr::recode(x, "Normal" = "Normal-Like"), levels = pam_levels_full)
}
clean_tp53 <- function(x) {
  x[is.na(x) | x == ""] <- "Unknown"
  factor(x, levels = tp53_levels_full)
}

pam_brca_ann   <- clean_pam (as.character(metadata[brca_b$ids, "Subtype_Selected"]))
tp53_brca_ann  <- clean_tp53(as.character(metadata[brca_b$ids, "TP53"]))
pam_scanb_ann  <- clean_pam (as.character(SummarizedExperiment::colData(scanb_tumor)[scanb_b$ids, "SSP.PAM50"]))
tp53_scanb_ann <- clean_tp53(as.character(SummarizedExperiment::colData(scanb_tumor)[scanb_b$ids, "TP53"]))
pam_metab_ann  <- clean_pam (as.character(SummarizedExperiment::colData(metabric_se)[metab_b$ids, "Pam50_SUBTYPE"]))
tp53_metab_ann <- clean_tp53(as.character(SummarizedExperiment::colData(metabric_se)[metab_b$ids, "TP53"]))
```

## PAM50 deviation across cohorts

3 cohort rows × 1 PAM50 column. Adjacent Normal (TCGA NAT) included as leftmost reference. Kruskal-Wallis omnibus across the 5 tumor subtypes (NAT excluded from the test — visual anchor only).

```{r panelD_build}
ids_brca_d <- rownames(cs_pt$cs$phi)
ids_scanb_d <- rownames(cs_scanb$cs$phi)

metab_cd    <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(metabric_se))

clean_pam_str <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x); x[is.na(x) | x == "" | x == "NC"] <- NA_character_
  dplyr::recode(x, "Normal" = "Normal-Like")
}

pam50_levels_D <- c("Adjacent Normal", "Normal-Like", "LumA", "LumB", "Her2", "Basal")

panelD_df <- bind_rows(
  tibble(cohort = "TCGA-BRCA", group = "Adjacent Normal",
         deviation = as.numeric(cs_nt$cs$deviation)),
  tibble(cohort = "TCGA-BRCA", group = clean_pam_str(metadata[ids_brca_d, "Subtype_Selected"]),
         deviation = as.numeric(cs_pt$cs$deviation)),
  tibble(cohort = "SCAN-B",    group = clean_pam_str(scanb_cd[ids_scanb_d, "SSP.PAM50"]),
         deviation = as.numeric(cs_scanb$cs$deviation)),
  tibble(cohort = "METABRIC",  group = clean_pam_str(metab_cd[ids_metab_d, "Pam50_SUBTYPE"]),
         deviation = as.numeric(cs_metab$cs$deviation))
) %>%
  filter(group %in% pam50_levels_D, is.finite(deviation)) %>%
  mutate(
    cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("TCGA-BRCA", "SCAN-B", "METABRIC")),
    group  = factor(group,  levels = pam50_levels_D)
  )

panelD_df %>% dplyr::count(cohort, group) %>% arrange(cohort, group)
```

```{r panelD_tests}
fmt_p <- function(p) {
  if (!is.finite(p)) return("p = NA")
  if (p < 2.2e-16) return("p < 2.2e-16")
  paste0("p = ", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2))
}

panelD_pvals <- panelD_df %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    d <- .x %>% filter(group != "Adjacent Normal") %>% mutate(group = droplevels(group))
    if (length(unique(d$group)) < 2) return(tibble(p_value = NA_real_))
    tibble(p_value = suppressWarnings(kruskal.test(deviation ~ group, data = d)$p.value))
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(p_label = paste0("Kruskal-Wallis ", fmt_p(p_value))) %>%
  ungroup()

panelD_pvals
```

## Pathway × PAM50 (3 cohorts)

Mean ClockSHAP contribution by PAM50 subtype for the six driver pathways.
NAT shown as a grey square at the leftmost x-position. Save dimensions: 7 × 5 in.

```{r panelG}
poi_pathways <- c(
  "G2m Checkpoint",
  "Glycolysis",
  "Myogenesis",
  "P53 Pathway",
  "Wnt Beta Catenin Signaling",
  "Unfolded Protein Response"
)

pam50_order <- c("Adjacent Normal", "Normal-Like", "LumA", "LumB", "Her2", "Basal")

build_phi_long <- function(cs_obj, pam_vec, age_vec, cohort_label, poi) {
  phi <- cs_obj$cs$phi
  ids <- rownames(phi)
  poi_avail <- intersect(colnames(phi), poi)
  pam <- as.character(pam_vec[ids])
  pam[is.na(pam) | pam == "" | pam == "NC"] <- "Unclassified"
  pam <- dplyr::recode(pam, "Normal" = "Normal-Like")
  as.data.frame(phi[, poi_avail, drop = FALSE]) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-sample_id, names_to = "pathway", values_to = "phi") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      PAM50     = pam[match(sample_id, ids)],
      age_years = as.numeric(age_vec[sample_id]),
      cohort    = cohort_label
    )
}

pam_pt    <- setNames(as.character(metadata$Subtype_Selected),       rownames(metadata))
pam_scanb <- setNames(as.character(colData(scanb_tumor)$SSP.PAM50),  colnames(scanb_tumor))
pam_metab <- setNames(as.character(colData(metabric_se)$Pam50_SUBTYPE), colnames(metabric_se))

phi_long_c <- bind_rows(
  build_phi_long(cs_pt,    pam_pt,    age_pt_full,    "TCGA-BRCA", poi_pathways),

  filter(PAM50 %in% pam50_order)
```

# 11. Overall survival across TCGA-BRCA + SCAN-B + METABRIC

Stacked OS analysis. Three cohorts share `Surv(time, event) ~ age + deviation`
Cox models and deviation-tertile KM curves administratively censored at
SCAN-B's natural max follow-up. Time normalized to days across all three cohorts
(METABRIC `OS_MONTHS` × 30.4375).

## 11.1 — Load TCGA-BRCA clinical + helpers

```{r load_clinical_helpers}
stopifnot(file.exists(params$clinical_csv))
clinical <- utils::read.csv(
  params$clinical_csv,
  na.strings        = c("NA", "", "#N/A"),
  stringsAsFactors  = FALSE,
  check.names       = TRUE
)

get_patient12 <- function(x) substr(as.character(x), 1, 12)

# Canonical PAM50 ordering for survival (no NAT — tumors only)
pam50_surv <- c("Normal-Like", "LumA", "LumB", "Her2", "Basal", "Unclassified")

harmonize_pam50 <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | x == "" | x == "NC"] <- "Unclassified"
  x <- dplyr::recode(x, "Normal" = "Normal-Like")
  factor(x, levels = pam50_surv)
}

# Survival helper — same Cox extractor as the survival figure script
cox_term <- function(df, formula_str, term_name) {
  fit <- survival::coxph(stats::as.formula(formula_str), data = df)
  co  <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  if (!term_name %in% rownames(co)) return(NULL)
  tibble::tibble(
    HR      = exp(co[term_name, "coef"]),
    CI_low  = exp(co[term_name, "coef"] - 1.96 * co[term_name, "se(coef)"]),
    CI_high = exp(co[term_name, "coef"] + 1.96 * co[term_name, "se(coef)"]),
    p_value = co[term_name, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  )
}
```

## 11.2 — Assemble per-cohort survival data frames

```{r assemble_surv}
# TCGA-BRCA: deviation/age from cs_pt, OS from TCGA-IntegratedClinical
ids_brca_s <- rownames(cs_pt$cs$phi)
tum_brca <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_id = ids_brca_s,
  age_years = cs_pt$cs$age,
  Deviation = cs_pt$cs$deviation,
  PAM50     = harmonize_pam50(metadata[ids_brca_s, "Subtype_Selected"])
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(patient12 = get_patient12(metadata[sample_id, "tcga.tcga_barcode"]))

clin2 <- clinical %>%
  dplyr::mutate(patient12 = get_patient12(bcr_patient_barcode)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(patient12, .keep_all = TRUE)

surv_brca <- tum_brca %>%
  dplyr::left_join(clin2, by = "patient12") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    time   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(OS.time)),
    event  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(OS)) == 1,
    cohort = "TCGA-BRCA"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(time), !is.na(event), is.finite(age_years),
                is.finite(Deviation), !is.na(PAM50), PAM50 != "Unclassified") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(PAM50 = factor(droplevels(factor(PAM50)), levels = pam50_surv))

# SCAN-B: OS_days and OS_event are expected to be present in colData(scanb_tumor).
# If your raw scanbe_se.rds uses different column names (e.g. Patient.OS.event /
# OverallSurvivalDays), map them to OS_days/OS_event upstream — section 2 — and
# re-run. The check below makes the failure mode obvious if they're missing.
scanb_cd_surv <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(scanb_tumor))
stopifnot(
  "SCAN-B colData must contain OS_days and OS_event columns" =
    all(c("OS_days", "OS_event") %in% colnames(scanb_cd_surv))
)
ids_scanb_s <- rownames(cs_scanb$cs$phi)

surv_scanb <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_id = ids_scanb_s,
  age_years = cs_scanb$cs$age,
  Deviation = cs_scanb$cs$deviation,
  PAM50     = harmonize_pam50(scanb_cd_surv[ids_scanb_s, "SSP.PAM50"]),
  time      = as.numeric(scanb_cd_surv[ids_scanb_s, "OS_days"]),
  event     = as.numeric(scanb_cd_surv[ids_scanb_s, "OS_event"]) > 0,
  cohort    = "SCAN-B"
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(time), !is.na(event), is.finite(age_years),
                is.finite(Deviation), !is.na(PAM50), PAM50 != "Unclassified") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(PAM50 = factor(droplevels(factor(PAM50)), levels = pam50_surv))

# METABRIC: OS_MONTHS -> days; OS_STATUS parsed to boolean
ids_metab_s  <- rownames(cs_metab$cs$phi)
mb_cd_surv   <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(metabric_se))
raw_event_mb <- as.character(mb_cd_surv[ids_metab_s, "OS_STATUS"])

surv_metab <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_id = ids_metab_s,
  age_years = cs_metab$cs$age,
  Deviation = cs_metab$cs$deviation,
  PAM50     = harmonize_pam50(mb_cd_surv[ids_metab_s, "Pam50_SUBTYPE"]),
  time      = as.numeric(mb_cd_surv[ids_metab_s, "OS_MONTHS"]) * 30.4375,
  event     = dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("DECEASED", raw_event_mb, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ TRUE,
    grepl("LIVING",   raw_event_mb, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ FALSE,
    TRUE                                                ~ NA
  ),
  cohort    = "METABRIC"
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(time), !is.na(event), is.finite(age_years),
                is.finite(Deviation), !is.na(PAM50), PAM50 != "Unclassified") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(PAM50 = factor(droplevels(factor(PAM50)), levels = pam50_surv))

cohort_surv_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  surv_brca  %>% dplyr::summarise(cohort = "TCGA-BRCA (OS)", n = dplyr::n(), events = sum(event)),
  surv_scanb %>% dplyr::summarise(cohort = "SCAN-B (OS)",    n = dplyr::n(), events = sum(event)),
  surv_metab %>% dplyr::summarise(cohort = "METABRIC (OS)",  n = dplyr::n(), events = sum(event))
)
knitr::kable(cohort_surv_summary, caption = "OS cohort sizes after filtering.")
```

## 11.3 — Cox forest, 3 cohorts stacked

Aggregate `age + Deviation`, PAM50-adjusted aggregate, and within-subtype
rows for each cohort. HR < 1 in blue (more youthful = worse), HR > 1 in red
(less youthful = worse). Save dimensions: 4 × 6.75 in.

```{r panelE_table}
run_aggregate_set <- function(df, cohort_label) {
  rows <- list()

  rows[[1]] <- cox_term(
    df, "survival::Surv(time, event) ~ age_years + Deviation", "Deviation"
  ) %>% dplyr::mutate(model = "All tumors",
                      n = nrow(df), events = sum(df$event))

  if (nlevels(droplevels(df$PAM50)) > 1) {
    rows[[2]] <- cox_term(
      df, "survival::Surv(time, event) ~ age_years + Deviation + PAM50", "Deviation"
    ) %>% dplyr::mutate(model = "All tumors (PAM50-adjusted)",
                        n = nrow(df), events = sum(df$event))
  }

  sub_rows <- purrr::map_dfr(levels(droplevels(df$PAM50)), function(s) {
    d <- dplyr::filter(df, PAM50 == s)
    if (nrow(d) < 5 || sum(d$event) < 2) return(NULL)
    res <- cox_term(
      d, "survival::Surv(time, event) ~ age_years + Deviation", "Deviation"
    )
    if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
    res %>% dplyr::mutate(
      model = paste("Subtype:", s),
      n = nrow(d), events = sum(d$event)
    )
  })

  out <- dplyr::bind_rows(rows, sub_rows)
  if (nrow(out) == 0) return(out)
  out %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cohort = cohort_label,
      sig    = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "p < 0.05", "p ≥ 0.05"),
      hr_dir = ifelse(HR < 1, "Youthful deviation, increased risk",
                              "Less-youthful deviation, increased risk")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(cohort, model, n, events, HR, CI_low, CI_high, p_value, sig, hr_dir)
}

panelE_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  run_aggregate_set(surv_brca,  "TCGA-BRCA (OS)"),
  run_aggregate_set(surv_scanb, "SCAN-B (OS)"),
  run_aggregate_set(surv_metab, "METABRIC (OS)")
)

knitr::kable(panelE_tbl, digits = 4,
             caption = "OS Cox forest, 3 cohorts.")
```

## 11.4 — KM by deviation tertile, 3 cohorts stacked (not used in the manuscript)

Within-cohort deviation tertiles. T1 = most youthful, T3 = least youthful.
Truncated at SCAN-B's natural max follow-up; log-rank also administratively
censored at that horizon so plot and test cover the same patient-time window.
Save dimensions: 3 × 6.75 in.

```{r panelF_data}
add_dev_tertile <- function(df) {
  qs <- stats::quantile(df$Deviation, probs = c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  df$dev_tertile <- cut(
    df$Deviation, breaks = qs,
    labels = c("T1: Most youthful", "T2: Middle", "T3: Least youthful"),
    include.lowest = TRUE
  )
  df
}

km_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  add_dev_tertile(surv_brca)  %>% dplyr::mutate(cohort = "TCGA-BRCA (OS)"),
  add_dev_tertile(surv_scanb) %>% dplyr::mutate(cohort = "SCAN-B (OS)"),
  add_dev_tertile(surv_metab) %>% dplyr::mutate(cohort = "METABRIC (OS)")
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cohort      = factor(cohort, levels = c("TCGA-BRCA (OS)", "SCAN-B (OS)", "METABRIC (OS)")),
    dev_tertile = factor(dev_tertile,
                         levels = c("T1: Most youthful", "T2: Middle", "T3: Least youthful"))
  )

# Truncation horizon = SCAN-B's natural max follow-up (the limiting cohort).
x_max <- km_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(cohort == "SCAN-B (OS)") %>%
  dplyr::pull(time) %>%
  max(na.rm = TRUE) / 365.25

trunc_data <- function(d, t_max_years) {
  t_max_days <- t_max_years * 365.25
  d %>% dplyr::mutate(
    event = event & time <= t_max_days,
    time  = pmin(time, t_max_days)
  )
}

km_data_view <- trunc_data(km_data, x_max)

km_curves <- km_data_view %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cohort, dev_tertile) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(function(d, .) {
    if (nrow(d) < 5 || sum(d$event) < 1) return(tibble::tibble())
    fit <- survival::survfit(survival::Surv(time, event) ~ 1, data = d)
    tibble::tibble(time = fit$time, surv = fit$surv,
                   n_risk = fit$n.risk, n_event = fit$n.event)
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Per-cohort log-rank on truncated data
lr_brca  <- survival::survdiff(
  survival::Surv(time, event) ~ dev_tertile,
  data = dplyr::filter(km_data_view, cohort == "TCGA-BRCA (OS)")
)
lr_scanb <- survival::survdiff(
  survival::Surv(time, event) ~ dev_tertile,
  data = dplyr::filter(km_data_view, cohort == "SCAN-B (OS)")
)
lr_metab <- survival::survdiff(
  survival::Surv(time, event) ~ dev_tertile,
  data = dplyr::filter(km_data_view, cohort == "METABRIC (OS)")
)

lr_p <- function(sd) 1 - stats::pchisq(sd$chisq, length(sd$n) - 1)

logrank_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  cohort         = c("TCGA-BRCA (OS)", "SCAN-B (OS)", "METABRIC (OS)"),
  log_rank_chisq = c(lr_brca$chisq, lr_scanb$chisq, lr_metab$chisq),
  p_value        = c(lr_p(lr_brca), lr_p(lr_scanb), lr_p(lr_metab))
)
knitr::kable(
  logrank_tbl, digits = 4,
  caption = sprintf(
    "Unadjusted log-rank test by deviation tertile, per cohort (administratively censored at %.2f years to match SCAN-B follow-up).",
    x_max
  )
)
```

# 12. Stability diagnostics

## 12.1 Hallmark coverage in the common universe

```{r diag_hallmark_coverage}
hallmark_sizes <- tibble(
  pathway = names(hallmark_sets),
  n_total = vapply(hallmark_sets, length, integer(1))
)

count_present <- function(universe) {
  vapply(hallmark_sets, function(g) sum(g %in% universe), integer(1))
}

retained_pathways <- names(b_orig)[b_orig != 0]
top_contrib       <- names(sort(abs(b_orig), decreasing = TRUE))[1:10]

coverage_tbl <- hallmark_sizes %>%
  mutate(
    n_gtex     = count_present(rownames(logcpm_gtex_sym)),
    n_tcga_pt  = count_present(rownames(logcpm_pt_sym)),
    n_scanb    = count_present(rownames(logcpm_scanb_sym)),
    n_metab    = count_present(rownames(logcpm_metab_sym)),
    n_common   = count_present(universe_common),
    pct_common = round(100 * n_common / n_total, 1),
    retained_in_clock = pathway %in% retained_pathways,
    top10_contrib     = pathway %in% top_contrib
  ) %>%
  arrange(pct_common)

cat("Coverage in common universe:\n")
cat("  Median %:    ", round(median(coverage_tbl$pct_common), 1), "\n")
cat("  Min %:       ", round(min(coverage_tbl$pct_common), 1),
    " (", coverage_tbl$pathway[which.min(coverage_tbl$pct_common)], ")\n", sep = "")
cat("  # < 60%:     ", sum(coverage_tbl$pct_common < 60), " of 50\n")
cat("  # < 80%:     ", sum(coverage_tbl$pct_common < 80), " of 50\n")

cat("\nClock-retained pathways — coverage in common universe:\n")
cat("  Median %:    ", round(median(coverage_tbl$pct_common[coverage_tbl$retained_in_clock]), 1), "\n")
cat("  Min %:       ", round(min(coverage_tbl$pct_common[coverage_tbl$retained_in_clock]), 1), "\n")

print(coverage_tbl)
```

## 12.2 Original (full universe) vs retrained (common universe) clock comparison

```{r diag_clock_comparison}
orig_clock_path <- file.path(proc_dir, "clock_and_RAA_objects-PC.rds")
stopifnot(file.exists(orig_clock_path))
orig_clock <- readRDS(orig_clock_path)

required_slots <- c("feature_names", "tuning", "enet_model", "clock_raw")
stopifnot(length(setdiff(required_slots, names(orig_clock))) == 0)

orig_alpha  <- orig_clock$tuning$best_alpha
orig_lambda <- orig_clock$tuning$best_lambda
orig_b      <- orig_clock$clock_raw$beta
orig_a      <- orig_clock$clock_raw$alpha
orig_feats  <- orig_clock$feature_names

orig_metric_col <- if (orig_clock$tuning$lambda_choice == "lambda.min") "MAE.min" else "MAE.1se"
orig_mae <- orig_clock$tuning$tune_table %>%
  dplyr::filter(abs(alpha - orig_alpha) < 1e-9) %>%
  dplyr::pull(.data[[orig_metric_col]])

new_alpha  <- best_alpha
new_lambda <- best_lambda
new_b      <- b_orig
new_a      <- a_orig
new_mae    <- best_mae
new_feats  <- feat

# Hyperparameter table
hp_tbl <- tibble(
  metric = c("alpha", "lambda", "intercept",
             paste0("CV MAE (", orig_clock$tuning$lambda_choice, ")"),
             "n features (Hallmarks)",
             "n retained (nonzero)"),
  original  = c(signif(orig_alpha, 3),  signif(orig_lambda, 4),  signif(orig_a, 4),
                signif(orig_mae, 4),    length(orig_feats),       sum(orig_b != 0)),
  retrained = c(signif(new_alpha, 3),   signif(new_lambda, 4),   signif(new_a, 4),
                signif(new_mae, 4),     length(new_feats),        sum(new_b != 0))
)
cat("Hyperparameter & training-fit comparison:\n")
print(hp_tbl)

# Coefficient agreement
all_paths <- union(orig_feats, new_feats)
comp <- tibble(
  pathway   = all_paths,
  orig_coef = as.numeric(orig_b[all_paths]),
  new_coef  = as.numeric(new_b[all_paths])
) %>%
  mutate(
    orig_coef = ifelse(is.na(orig_coef), 0, orig_coef),
    new_coef  = ifelse(is.na(new_coef),  0, new_coef),
    in_orig   = orig_coef != 0,
    in_new    = new_coef  != 0,
    sign_agree = sign(orig_coef) == sign(new_coef)
  )

both_retained   <- sum(comp$in_orig & comp$in_new)
either_retained <- sum(comp$in_orig | comp$in_new)
jaccard_retained <- both_retained / either_retained

cat("\nPathway-set agreement:\n")
cat("  Retained in both:           ", both_retained, "\n")
cat("  Retained in original only:  ", sum(comp$in_orig & !comp$in_new), "\n")
cat("  Retained in retrained only: ", sum(!comp$in_orig & comp$in_new), "\n")
cat("  Jaccard (retained set):     ", round(jaccard_retained, 3), "\n")

shared <- comp %>% filter(in_orig & in_new)
spearman_shared <- cor(shared$orig_coef, shared$new_coef, method = "spearman")
sign_concord_shared <- mean(shared$sign_agree)

cat("\nCoefficient agreement on shared retained pathways (n=", nrow(shared), "):\n", sep = "")
cat("  Spearman:                   ", round(spearman_shared, 3), "\n")
cat("  Sign concordance:           ", round(sign_concord_shared, 3), "\n")

# Coefficient scatter
ggplot(comp, aes(orig_coef, new_coef)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey60") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_point(aes(color = case_when(
    in_orig &  in_new ~ "Both",
    in_orig & !in_new ~ "Original only",
    !in_orig &  in_new ~ "Retrained only",
    TRUE ~ "Neither"
  )), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    Both = "#1f78b4", `Original only` = "#e31a1c",
    `Retrained only` = "#33a02c", Neither = "grey85"
  ), name = NULL) +
  labs(
    x = "Coefficient — original clock (GTEx ∩ TCGA universe)",
    y = "Coefficient — retrained clock (common universe)",
    title = "Pathway coefficients: original vs retrained"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
